questions: Founded in 1978 in a village in southeastern Turkey, this Kurdish militant and political organization has waged an insurgency across the mountainous Kurdish-majority regions of Turkey, Iraq, and Syria — name the group?

Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) is a Kurdish militant political organization and armed guerrilla group primarily based in the mountainous Kurdish-majority regions of southeastern Turkey, northern Iraq and north-eastern Syria.
